title: Depths of constant gates
statement: Let $l$ be a list of Boolean values and let $I$ be a list of natural numbers. Starting with the values in $I$, append the depth of each constant gate associated with an entry of $l$, in the order of the entries. The resulting list is $I$ followed by $l.length$ copies of $1$.
